security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Two-factor authentication and backup codes
security.backupDescription: Backup codes let you sign in without your authenticator app (one code = one sign-in). Regeneration invalidates all old codes and creates 10 new ones — old codes will stop working.
security.newCodesDescription: — save them now, they won't be shown again:
security.disableDescription: After disabling, signing in to the admin panel will require setting up 2FA again. All backup codes will also be invalidated. This action cannot be undone.
security.disableConfirm: Really disable 2FA? All backup codes will be invalidated.

twoFactor.setupText: Admin panel access requires two-factor authentication. Open an Authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password) and scan the QR code.
twoFactor.codeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code from your app
twoFactor.activatedText: Save these backup codes in a safe place. Each code can be used exactly once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will only be shown this once.
twoFactor.verifyText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.notConfiguredText2: is not set. Contact the server administrator.
